jobs.title: VP Procurement, Indirect Spend
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Vice President Indirect Spend leads the global management of indirect spend categories, driving strategic sourcing, procurement operations, and supplier partnerships that support business growth. This role is responsible for optimizing cost, mitigating risk, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring compliance while maintaining Barry Callebaut’s quality standards. The position leads a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues through 10 direct reports and collaborates closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

Key Responsibilities Include

•
 Lead the global sourcing and purchasing operations for indirect spend categories, ensuring financial and operational objectives are achieved

•
 Identify business objectives and link them to supplier capabilities

• Develop and execute a global indirect procurement strategy that optimizes cost, mitigates risk, and delivers sustainable business value

• Drive strategic sourcing initiatives through the consistent application of sourcing best practices and methodologies

•
 Deliver sourcing commitments by identifying, developing, and implementing value-generating procurement projects

•
 Develop and continuously improve harmonized procurement processes, tools, templates, KPIs, and organizational design

• Identify new purchasing opportunities and savings strategies across indirect spend categories

• Negotiate favorable commercial and contractual terms with suppliers to maximize value for the business

•
 Build strong partnerships with key business stakeholders to jointly deliver business objectives

• Leverage technology and digital solutions to enhance sourcing effectiveness and procurement performance

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Procurement, or a related field is required

• Master’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred

• At least 10 years of procurement experience within an FMCG / Manufacturing based industry

•
 Minimum 5 years of experience leading a complex Regional and / or Global procurement function

• In-depth knowledge of procurement best practices and strategic sourcing methodologies

•
 Experience managing multiple indirect spend categories such as Logistics, Energy, Packaging, CapEx, and Professional Services is preferred

• Strong negotiation, influencing, stakeholder management, and strategy development skills

• Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration capabilities

• A leadership style that promotes teamwork, innovation, inclusion, accountability, and high ethical standards

•
 Willingness to travel internationally approximately 15% of the time

• Fluency in English is required

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Vice Presidente Indirect Spend conduce la gestione globale delle categorie di spesa indiretta, guidando l'asporto strategico, le operazioni di approvvigionamento e i partenariati dei fornitori che sostengono la crescita aziendale. Questo ruolo è responsabile dell’ottimizzazione dei costi, della mitigazione dei rischi, del miglioramento dell’efficienza operativa e della conformità, pur mantenendo gli standard qualitativi di Barry Callebaut. La posizione conduce un'organizzazione globale di circa 100 colleghi attraverso 10 rapporti diretti e collabora strettamente con gli stakeholder senior in tutto il business.

Responsabilità chiave

•
Guidare le operazioni di approvvigionamento e acquisto globali per le categorie di spesa indiretta, garantendo obiettivi finanziari e operativi

•
Identificare gli obiettivi aziendali e collegarli alle capacità dei fornitori

• Sviluppare ed eseguire una strategia globale di approvvigionamento indiretto che ottimizza i costi, mitiga il rischio e fornisce un valore aziendale sostenibile

• Guidare iniziative di approvvigionamento strategico attraverso l'applicazione coerente di migliori pratiche e metodologie di approvvigionamento

•
Fornire impegni di approvvigionamento mediante l'identificazione, lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di progetti di approvvigionamento generati dal valore

•
Sviluppare e migliorare continuamente processi di approvvigionamento armonizzati, strumenti, modelli, KPI e progettazione organizzativa

• Identificare nuove opportunità di acquisto e strategie di risparmio attraverso le categorie di spesa indiretta

• Negoziare i termini commerciali e contrattuali favorevoli con i fornitori per massimizzare il valore per il business

•
Costruire partnership forti con i principali stakeholder aziendali per fornire obiettivi di business congiuntamente

• Tecnologia di levaggio e soluzioni digitali per migliorare l'efficacia e le prestazioni di approvvigionamento

A proposito di te

• Corso di laurea in Business, appalti, o un campo relativo è richiesto

• Laurea magistrale in Business, Finanza, o una disciplina correlata è preferito

• Almeno 10 anni di esperienza di approvvigionamento all'interno di un'industria basata su FMCG / Manufacturing

•
Minimo 5 anni di esperienza che conduce una complessa funzione di approvvigionamento regionale e/o globale

• Conoscenza approfondita delle migliori pratiche di approvvigionamento e metodologie di approvvigionamento strategico

•
L'esperienza di gestione di più categorie di spesa indiretta come logistica, energia, imballaggio, CapEx e servizi professionali è preferito

• Forte negoziazione, influenza, gestione degli stakeholder e competenze di sviluppo di strategia

• Caratteristiche analitiche, problem solving, comunicazione e collaborazione

• Uno stile di leadership che promuove il lavoro di squadra, l'innovazione, l'inclusione, la responsabilità e elevati standard etici

•
Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale circa il 15% del tempo

• Fluency in inglese è richiesto

• Un style de leadership qui favorise le travail d'équipe, l'innovation, l'inclusion, la responsabilisation et des normes éthiques élevées

Volonté de voyager à l'étranger environ 15% du temps

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Manager - Gourmet Business

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur de l'excellence commerciale - Gourmet Business

jobs.description:
About the Role

Reporting directly to the Director of Distribution Excellence you will play a relevant role in implementing our distribution and indirect channel model to the near future, deploying models and frameworks that will elevate our commercial performance in a global scale. This role requires accurate hands-on attitude, superior change management capabilities and enhanced experience on management of commercial activities and distribution framework in order to bring to life an effective and modern Distribution Excellence framework.

The main purpose of this role is to leverage our growth based on implementation of models and frameworks that will optimize and enhance our distribution network based on distribution strategic partnerships, supported by data-driven and performance-led collaborative program with our Distribution Partners, through enhanced data sharing and market visibility, improving collaboration, speed-to-market and business resilience. The Distribution Excellence Enablement Manager will act as the constructor of our Distribution programs.

Based on strong stakeholder management and strong entrepreneurship mindset, the implementation and development of a robust and pragmatic Strategic Distribution model will allow Barry Callebaut to deliver above the market growth based on end user and partner’s satisfaction and collaboration, shaping a successful model that will greatly support the activities of our Commercial teams around the globe.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Execute market research in order to build our Distribution Landscape assessment, including evaluation of the distribution footprint and reach and Delayered Distribution possibilities, looking for opportunities to drive growth, optimize efficiency and performance of our route to market and distribution network

• Distributor Capability Building – Define and deploy the sales excellence toolkits

• Pricing Governance – Ensure adoption of pricelist governance and track adherence

• Digital Ordering Capabilities – Enable distributors and drive adoption of Digital ordering capabilities deployed towards customers

• Develop comprehensive insights based on global and regional distribution landscape, identifying key trends, challenges, and opportunities to define our commercial background in different markets, mapping similarities and discrepancies

• Build a robust platform to strengthen strategic distributor engagement and training, enhancing capabilities and ensuring alignment with business goals

• Help to establish the global Distribution Excellence framework: Building clarity through the development of the details of the selected distribution models, synergizing channels, reducing channel conflicts, identifying resources needed as well as optimizing processes and aligning on interdependencies

• Support the implementation of the Commercial Intelligence insights model through the definition of relevant leading measures to drive growth and performance mainly aligned with the implementation of the systematic collection of the Secondary Sales Data (SSD) from our Strategic Partners

• Responsible for the interface with other departments (Digital, PMO and others) in order to build alignment in terms of project management, timelines and resources, aiming to leverage the positive impact of the Distribution Excellence framework

• Responsible for regular analysis of global and regional distribution performance, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement to drive continuous enhancement of our growth, distribution strategies and activation on the ground, based on Commercial Intelligence Analysis

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, or a related field

• Advanced degree - Master’s or MBA desired

• Proven track record on Commercial management roles or similar with experience on projects implementation

• Experience with Distribution Management highly desirable

• Project and Change Management experiences and stakeholder management skills will be considered as a plus

• Fluent in English, as it is the primary language of global business communication

• Additional language proficiency desirable

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo

Segnalando direttamente al Direttore di Eccellenza di Distribuzione svolgerai un ruolo rilevante nell'attuazione del nostro modello di distribuzione e canale indiretto al prossimo futuro, implementando modelli e quadri che eleveranno le nostre prestazioni commerciali in scala globale. Questo ruolo richiede un atteggiamento preciso, capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti superiori e una maggiore esperienza nella gestione delle attività commerciali e del quadro di distribuzione al fine di portare a vita un quadro efficace e moderno di eccellenza di distribuzione.

Lo scopo principale di questo ruolo è quello di sfruttare la nostra crescita basata sull'implementazione di modelli e framework che ottimizzano e valorizzeranno la nostra rete di distribuzione basata su partnership strategiche di distribuzione, supportate da un programma collaborativo basato sui dati e sulle prestazioni con i nostri partner di distribuzione, attraverso una maggiore condivisione dei dati e visibilità del mercato, migliorando la collaborazione, la velocità al mercato e la resilienza aziendale. L'Eccellenza di distribuzione Enablement Manager fungerà da costruttore dei nostri programmi di distribuzione.

Sulla base di una forte gestione degli stakeholder e di una forte mentalità di imprenditorialità, l’implementazione e lo sviluppo di un modello di distribuzione strategica robusto e pragmatico permetterà a Barry Callebaut di offrire al di sopra della crescita del mercato basata sulla soddisfazione e sulla collaborazione dell’utente finale e del partner, modellando un modello di successo che sosterrà notevolmente le attività dei nostri team commerciali in tutto il mondo.

Responsabilità chiave

• Eseguire la ricerca di mercato al fine di costruire la nostra valutazione del paesaggio di distribuzione, compresa la valutazione dell'impronta di distribuzione e raggiungere e le possibilità di distribuzione delayered, alla ricerca di opportunità per guidare la crescita, ottimizzare l'efficienza e le prestazioni del nostro percorso per il mercato e la rete di distribuzione

• Distributore Capability Building – Definire e distribuire i toolkit di eccellenza di vendita

• Governance dei prezzi – Assicurare l'adozione della governance dei listino prezzi e l'adesione della pista

• Capacità di ordinazione digitale – Abilita distributori e aziona l'adozione di capacità di ordinazione digitale implementate verso i clienti

• Sviluppare approfondimenti basati sul panorama della distribuzione globale e regionale, identificare tendenze chiave, sfide e opportunità per definire il nostro background commerciale in diversi mercati, mappare somiglianze e discrepanze

• Costruire una piattaforma robusta per rafforzare il coinvolgimento e la formazione dei distributori strategici, migliorare le capacità e garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali

• Aiuta a stabilire il quadro globale di Eccellenza di Distribuzione: costruire chiarezza attraverso lo sviluppo dei dettagli dei modelli di distribuzione selezionati, canali sinergizzanti, ridurre i conflitti dei canali, identificare le risorse necessarie, nonché ottimizzare i processi e allineare le interdipendenze

• Sostenere l'implementazione del modello di insight dell'Intelligence Commerciale attraverso la definizione di misure rilevanti per guidare la crescita e le prestazioni principalmente allineate all'implementazione della raccolta sistematica dei Dati di Vendite Secondari (SSD) dai nostri partner strategici

• Responsabile per l'interfaccia con altri dipartimenti (Digital, PMO e altri) al fine di costruire allineamento in termini di gestione del progetto, tempi e risorse, al fine di sfruttare l'impatto positivo del quadro di Eccellenza di distribuzione

• Responsabile per l'analisi periodica delle prestazioni di distribuzione globali e regionali, l'individuazione di tendenze, opportunità e aree di miglioramento per promuovere il miglioramento continuo della nostra crescita, strategie di distribuzione e attivazione sul terreno, basato sull'analisi dell'intelligenza commerciale

A proposito di te

• Corso di laurea in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing o un campo relativo

• Grado avanzato - Master o MBA desiderato

• Provato record di traccia sui ruoli di gestione commerciale o simile con esperienza sull'implementazione dei progetti

• Esperienza con Gestione della distribuzione altamente auspicabile

• Le esperienze di Project and Change Management e le competenze di gestione degli stakeholder saranno considerate come un plus

• Fluente in inglese, in quanto è la lingua principale della comunicazione aziendale globale

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche auspicabili

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle

Wenn Sie direkt an den Director of Distribution Excellence berichten, werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Implementierung unseres Vertriebs- und indirekten Kanalmodells für die nahe Zukunft spielen und Modelle und Frameworks einsetzen, die unsere kommerzielle Leistung auf globaler Ebene steigern werden. Diese Rolle erfordert eine genaue praktische Einstellung, überlegene Change-Management-Fähigkeiten und erweiterte Erfahrung im Management von kommerziellen Aktivitäten und Vertriebsrahmen, um ein effektives und modernes Distribution Excellence-Rahmenwerk zum Leben zu erwecken.

Der Hauptzweck dieser Rolle ist es, unser Wachstum auf der Grundlage der Implementierung von Modellen und Frameworks zu nutzen, die unser Vertriebsnetzwerk auf der Grundlage strategischer Vertriebspartnerschaften optimieren und verbessern, unterstützt durch datengesteuertes und leistungsorientiertes Kooperationsprogramm mit unseren Vertriebspartnern, durch verbesserten Datenaustausch und Markttransparenz, Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit, der Geschwindigkeit bis zur Markteinführung und der Geschäftsresilienz. Der Distribution Excellence Enablement Manager fungiert als Konstrukteur unserer Distributionsprogramme.

Basierend auf einem starken Stakeholder-Management und einer starken unternehmerischen Denkweise wird die Implementierung und Entwicklung eines robusten und pragmatischen strategischen Vertriebsmodells es Barry Callebaut ermöglichen, auf der Grundlage der Zufriedenheit und Zusammenarbeit von Endbenutzern und Partnern über dem Marktwachstum zu liegen und ein erfolgreiches Modell zu entwickeln, das die Aktivitäten unserer kaufmännischen Teams auf der ganzen Welt stark unterstützen wird.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören

• Führen Sie Marktforschung durch, um unsere Distribution Landscape-Bewertung zu erstellen, einschließlich der Bewertung des Distributions-Fußabdrucks und der Reichweite sowie der Delayered Distribution-Möglichkeiten, und suchen Sie nach Möglichkeiten, um das Wachstum voranzutreiben, die Effizienz und Leistung unserer Route zum Markt und Vertriebsnetz zu optimieren.

• Distributor Capability Building – Definieren und implementieren Sie die Sales Excellence Toolkits

• Pricing Governance – Sicherstellen der Übernahme von Pricelist Governance und Track Compliance

• Digitale Bestellfunktionen - Ermöglichen Sie Distributoren und fördern Sie die Einführung digitaler Bestellfunktionen für Kunden

• Entwickeln Sie umfassende Erkenntnisse auf der Grundlage der globalen und regionalen Vertriebslandschaft, identifizieren Sie wichtige Trends, Herausforderungen und Möglichkeiten, um unseren kommerziellen Hintergrund in verschiedenen Märkten zu definieren, und kartieren Sie Ähnlichkeiten und Diskrepanzen

• Aufbau einer robusten Plattform zur Stärkung des strategischen Vertriebspartner-Engagements und -Trainings, Verbesserung der Fähigkeiten und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsziele

• Helfen Sie dabei, das globale Distribution Excellence Framework zu etablieren: Klarheit schaffen durch die Entwicklung der Details der ausgewählten Verteilungsmodelle, Synergien, Kanalkonflikte reduzieren, benötigte Ressourcen identifizieren sowie Prozesse optimieren und auf Interdependenzen ausrichten

• Unterstützung der Implementierung des Commercial Intelligence Insights-Modells durch die Definition relevanter Leitmaßnahmen zur Förderung von Wachstum und Leistung, die hauptsächlich auf die Implementierung der systematischen Erhebung der Secondary Sales Data (SSD) von unseren strategischen Partnern ausgerichtet sind

• Verantwortlich für die Schnittstelle zu anderen Abteilungen (Digital, PMO und andere), um eine Ausrichtung in Bezug auf Projektmanagement, Zeitpläne und Ressourcen zu erreichen und die positiven Auswirkungen des Distribution Excellence-Frameworks zu nutzen

• Verantwortlich für die regelmäßige Analyse der globalen und regionalen Vertriebsleistung, Identifizierung von Trends, Chancen und Verbesserungsbereichen, um die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unseres Wachstums, unserer Vertriebsstrategien und Aktivierung vor Ort auf der Grundlage der Commercial Intelligence Analyse voranzutreiben.

Über dich

As a co-manager of a proprietary trading book, the trader executes strategies in line with the approved trading mandate and GCRC guidelines. Positioned at the center of all terminal market transactions, the Cocoa Derivatives Trader plays a critical role in building and maintaining strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

The role involves close collaboration with colleagues across Sales, Product Trading, Cocoa Trading, and Chocolate businesses. As a market expert and thought leader, the trader contributes valuable market insights, partners with the Cocoa Research team to develop analyses, and leverages relationships with brokers, banks, Treasury, and Risk teams to support informed trading decisions and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Execute market trades to hedge price risk accurately and in a timely manner.

• Implement trading strategies in accordance with the approved trading mandate.

• Own and deliver the Trading P&L KPI.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Monitor and control daily positions, including the management of any resulting foreign exchange exposure.

• Develop and execute strategies involving futures, options, and OTC instruments.

• Manage expiring positions, coordinate roll activities with brokers and physical counterparties, and optimize transaction costs.

• Proactively cultivate broker relationships and communicate relevant market intelligence to sourcing teams.

• Identify and escalate regulatory, compliance, and control-related issues as appropriate.

• Monitor and support the technology landscape related to market information, market access, position management, and trading activities.

• Strong mathematical, quantitative, and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Strong interest in technology and digital trading environments.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Effective communicator with strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Reporting to the VP, CFO Global Cocoa, this position is the right hand of the VP, Cocoa Manufacturing, driving the decision-making process by focusing on the financial performance of operations as well as supply chain. It aims at originating and implementing growth opportunities and value for Global Cocoa on manufacturing costs and operational efficiency. It also supports financial reporting, planning and analysis, including “make or buy” deep dives. This position is a key player in shaping the mid and long-term strategy of Global Cocoa with respect to footprint and cost leadership.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as strategic advisory interface to the business and management for Customer Supply & Development (CSD) related matters, and specifically acting as right hand for the VP, Cocoa Manufacturing, in close cooperation with CFO CSD and CFO Global Cocoa

• Besides the global focus, the Finance BP CSD is also directly responsible for the Cocoa Region Western Europe, supported by 3 direct reports

• Provide financial insights before and during the global S&OP process, specifically on defining the most cost-efficient production location globally and comparing to external product purchases (make or buy decision)

• Lead the creation of cost data repository for logistic and factory costs to always take decisions based on latest information

• Support capacity expansion projects and footprint studies

• Maintaining the End-to-End Liquor Profitability model to determine the right benchmark for future business cases and enable having a Global Cocoa profitability consolidated view

• Create financial transparency in cross-functional cost efficiency projects from E2E perspective (Sourcing, Logistics, Manufacturing, R&D, Pricing)

• Given the importance of raw material costs, high focus on yields (beans, pressing) and waste reduction. Ensure yields are up to date with the risk teams for proper commodity hedging

• Close collaboration with Pricing teams to ensure pricing tool is loaded with the right costs (including yields).

• Lead monthly analysis of logistics cost drivers vs costs priced to customers thereby indicating optimization opportunities

• Together with FP&A, (Group and Regional FP&A) provide insights and analysis on overall CSD costs for Global Cocoa, especially on forward looking basis (rolling forecast)

• Setting up the right cost targets for budget and competitiveness, monitoring and evaluating performance against budget and prior year, identifying risks and opportunities and reviewing results and developing mitigating actions with the Finance BP’s on-site and plant management teams

• Ensure with local CSD FBP’s that proper inventory management processes and stock counts are performed, this includes enforcement of proper process order management

• Lead Global Cocoa CSD Finance team – consists of having the right profiles in the role and ensuring that they bring the right financial understanding to local site management team via coaching, developing and challenging

About You

• Minimum 15 years of experience in finance (controlling/financial planning/business development/project management)

• Experience in finance business partnering or financial planning and analysis within a production/industrial environment

• Preferably exposure to commodities, specifically soft commodities

• Minimum bachelor’s in economics, Finance, Business Administration, or similar. Master’s degree is a plus

• Fluency in English a must; French language skills would be an asset

• Proficiency in MS Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

• Knowledge of finance systems and business intelligence tools (SAP BOFC, BW, Analytics Cloud, EPM)

• Solid SAP/ BW knowledge is very much preferred; familiarity with master data and processes that impact enterprise-wide performance reporting

• Proficiency in MS Office Suite especially with Microsoft Excel, and PowerPoint is required; familiarity with KPI repositories, and data management tools are extremely helpful

• Understanding of accounting processes and standards (IFRS)

• Travel required depending on business needs (10-20%); Africa, South America, North America, Western Europe, Asia

The role works closely with trading, logistics, risk management, accounting and finance teams to provide transparency on financial performance and support informed decision-making. Through exposure to commodity markets, derivatives, supply chain finance and international trade, the position offers a unique opportunity to develop deep finance expertise within one of the world’s leading cocoa sourcing organizations.

With increasing experience, the role is expected to take on broader responsibility for complex analyses, key finance processes, and the identification and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities.

• Supports financial analysis related to trading performance and commodity market developments

• Supports forecasting and budgeting activities by providing reliable financial insights and recommendations

• Analyzes supply chain costs and operational performance drivers across the sourcing organization

• Translates complex financial information into clear and actionable insights for stakeholders for business partners and trading team

• Contributes to the broader Global Trading & Sourcing (GT&S) financial planning and performance management processes

• Continuously improves valuation methodologies, reporting quality and analytical tools

• In depth understanding of derivatives finance and financial markets. Interest in commodity markets

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills

• Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
